phrase: Hikers followed a chatbot into the backcountry and got lost. One AI company may simply rename its data centers, since that seemed easier than changing them.
phraseAlternatives: A chatbot pointed hikers the wrong way into the wilderness. A data center may soon get a friendlier name, though not a smaller one.
Outsourcing your hike to AI can leave you lost in the woods. Outsourcing an image problem to AI marketing just gets you a new sign.
AI gave hikers directions into danger. Elsewhere, a company found it easier to rename a data center than to make it smaller or quieter.
Trust an AI with your hike and you might end up off the path. Trust it with your reputation and you just end up with a new name.
alt: A split scene. On the left, a worried hiker points ahead toward a tilted speech bubble reading WRONG WAY, while a small sign reading TRAIL stands ignored off to the side. On the right, a data center with lit server racks has a new pill-shaped sign reading NEW NAME attached above its roof, with nothing else about the building changed.

brief.concept: A hiker trusts a chatbot's directions off the marked trail into the fog, while across town a data center gets a shiny new sign instead of a smaller footprint.
brief.metaphor: Renaming a problem instead of solving it: for the hiker, the real trail sign is ignored; for the data center, only the sign is new.
